summary:
Indeed is the job-search site at indeed.com. The blue wordmark in the tab is the icon search bookmarks request. A block page with no image is not published.

Checked 12 November 2026 against indeed.com. HTML came from https://www.indeed.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.indeed.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 11383 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.indeed.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 57×57 png.

Brand colour #003399 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-02.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-02.png at 180×180 (png, 2178 bytes) from https://www.indeed.com/apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png.
